youtube.title: Why flying higher actually saves fuel ✈️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Climbing burns a huge amount of fuel, so staying low should be cheaper. Right? Wrong. Planes are cheapest to fly way up high.

The higher you go, the thinner the air gets. Thinner air means less drag, so the same fuel takes a plane much further. The air is also around minus fifty degrees, and cold, dense intake air makes jet engines more efficient.

Full episode on the channel.
